issue: Reward candidates were offer records, while the existing event drag handler accepted only equipment already in player.instances. The current reward slot was also non-interactable.

behavior.source: Legendary three-choice and vault reward candidates
behavior.gesture: Press and move more than 6 CSS pixels to show the existing UICreator item ghost and highlight the valid slot; release there to select.
behavior.click: Press without movement or with small jitter remains normal selection.
behavior.confirmation: Dragging only changes selection. The existing claim button grants exactly one item and closes the remaining choices.
behavior.cancel: Invalid target, Escape, pointer cancellation or window blur leaves selection and inventory unchanged and clears ghost and highlight.
behavior.persistence: Closing and reopening retains the same candidates and selected reward.
behavior.regression: Owned equipment still drags into the two fusion inputs. UICreator remains the owner of item cells, ghost artwork and input brushes.
